matches.name: ui.components.scrollView
matches.purpose: Construct an authored finite scroll view through the official package's uniform entrypoint.
matches.when_to_use: Declare @unone/ui 0.3.0; the module and themed kit delegate to the same existing scroll helper. Read docs/ui-scroll.md and docs/ui-components.md for coordinates, lifecycle and current Web-only host support. Legacy api.ui.scrollView/virtualList/virtualGrid remain compatible.
matches.when_not_to_use: No theme style for scroll containers, automatic responsive layout, native scroll support or gameplay callback. Virtual renderItem is UI-pure and never advances Game.update or consumes RNG.

parameters.name: options
parameters.meaning: Viewport belongs to its containing space; content uses local top-left/y-down coordinates. Optional inertia=false and deceleration=8 (finite (0,100], exponential velocity decay in s^-1) configure Web host-only release motion; no elastic overscroll. Stable item keys and explicit fixed row/cell sizes are required for virtualization.

matches.returns: UiScrollNode (also a UiNode); preserve registered virtualList/virtualGrid handles when composing a screen/component.
side_effects: Construct scroll node; virtual helpers register UI-only materialization callbacks
matches.frame_semantics: Same lifecycle as the corresponding legacy helper; a wrapper does not duplicate a registration or run a simulation tick. Inertia is opt-in, uses host time and stops on new interaction, wheel, pause, geometry/config change, reset, disable, unmount or bounds.
common_errors: Do not clone registered virtual handles, author contentHeight/maxScroll, use stage coordinates in content or mutate gameplay in renderItem. Unsupported hosts report their capability boundary explicitly.

matches.name: ui.scrollView
matches.purpose: Create a reusable scroll_view node with measured local content and clipped rendering/input.
matches.when_to_use: Use for authored finite content. See docs/ui-scroll.md for coordinates, lifecycle and Web host integration.
matches.when_not_to_use: Not automatic responsive layout or a gameplay loop. Native/legacy DOM hosts currently reject this capability explicitly.

parameters.name: options
parameters.meaning: id, viewport, content; optional axis, enabled, resetKey, wheelRect, inertia=false and deceleration=8 (finite (0,100], exponential velocity decay in s^-1). Content rects are local top-left/y-down; only viewport is in its containing space.

matches.frame_semantics: Host scroll and optional release inertia do not advance gameplay. New input, pause, geometry/config changes, reset, disable, unmount and bounds stop motion. No elastic overscroll.
common_errors: Do not put stage-space rects in content or hand-author contentHeight/maxScroll.
